data.title: Intrinsic topological hinge states induced by boundary gauge fields in photonic metamaterials
data.author: Changsheng He, Liang Zhao, Shuang Zhang, Lei Zhou, Shaojie Ma
data.summary: Abstract Higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs) can support boundary states at least two dimensions lower than the bulk, attracting intensive attention from both fundamental science and application sides. Lattice-based tight-binding models such as Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes model have driven significant advancements in realizing HOTIs across various physical systems. Here, beyond lattice model, we demonstrate that a cylinder with an arbitrary cross section, composed of a homogeneous electromagnetic medium featuring nontrivial second Chern numbers $${c}_{2}=\pm 1$$ c 2 = ± 1 in a synthetic five-dimensional space, can exhibit topologically protected HOTI-type hinge states in three-dimensional laboratory space. Interestingly, this hinge state is essentially a chiral zero mode arising from the interaction between Weyl arc surface states, guaranteed by a nontrivial $${c}_{2}$$ c 2 , and an effective magnetic field induced by the curvature of the cylinder surface. Compared to conventional schemes to generate HOTIs, our approach is more robust, as it is an intrinsic topological phase and therefore does not rely on additional symmetry protections such as time-reversal, parity, or chiral symmetry. We experimentally realize such a cylinder using a photonic metamaterial and confirm the existence of hinge states via microwave near-field measurements. Our work introduces the concept of boundary gauge fields and establishes the link between synthetic-space $${c}_{2}$$ c 2 and real-space HOTI states, thereby generalizing HOTIs to corner-less systems.
data.title_cn: 光子超材料中边界规范场引起的本征拓扑铰链态
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI）可以支持比本体低至少两个维度的边界态，引起了基础科学和应用方面的强烈关注。基于格的紧束缚模型（例如 Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes 模型）推动了跨各种物理系统实现 HOTI 的重大进步。在这里，超越晶格模型，我们证明了具有任意横截面的圆柱体，由具有非平凡第二陈数 $${c}_{2}=\pm 1$$ c 2 = ± 1 的合成五维空间中的均匀电磁介质组成，可以在三维实验室空间中表现出拓扑保护的 HOTI 型铰链状态。有趣的是，这种铰链态本质上是由 Weyl 弧表面态之间相互作用产生的手性零模式，由非平凡的 $${c}_{2}$$ c 2 和圆柱表面曲率感应的有效磁场保证。与生成 HOTI 的传统方案相比，我们的方法更加稳健，因为它是内在的拓扑相，因此不依赖于额外的对称性保护，例如时间反转、宇称或手性对称性。我们使用光子超材料通过实验实现了这样的圆柱体，并通过微波近场测量确认了铰链态的存在。我们的工作引入了边界规范场的概念，并建立了合成空间 $${c}_{2}$$ c 2 和真实空间 HOTI 状态之间的联系，从而将 HOTI 推广到无角系统。

data.title: Reconfigurable versatile integrated photonic computing chip
data.author: Yufei Wang, Kun Liao, Kuo Zhang, Zhuochen Du, Ze Wang, Bo Ni, Tianyu Xu, Shuai Feng, Yan Yang, Qi-Fan Yang, Quan Sun, Xiaoyong Hu, Qihuang Gong
data.summary: Abstract With the rapid development of information technology, artificial intelligence and large-scale models have exhibited exceptional performance and widespread applications. Photonic hardware offers a promising solution to meet the growing demands for computational power and energy efficiency. Researchers have aimed to develop an efficient integrated photonic computing chip capable of supporting a wide range of application scenarios in both static and dynamic temporal domains. However, with several mainstream photonic components already well-developed, achieving fundamental breakthroughs at the level of basic computing units remains highly challenging. Here, we report a novel algorithm-hardware co-design strategy that enables in situ reconfigurability across diverse neural network models, all within a unified photonic configuration. We unlock the intrinsic capabilities of a compact cross-waveguide coupled microring component to natively support both static and dynamic temporal tasks. As a proof of concept, we experimentally integrated a turnkey soliton microcomb as the light source on the photonic computing platform, demonstrating the realization of fully connected, convolutional, and recurrent neural network models within a unified structure. The chip achieves area computing efficiency of up to 2.45 TOPS/mm 2 for 208 tunable components. We evaluate the performance of the proposed chip by implementing image classification tasks on the MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets, achieving measured test accuracies of 92.93% and 56.57%, respectively. Sentiment analysis on the IMDB dataset achieves a measured test accuracy of 80.81%. Furthermore, speech recognition is implemented by combining three neural networks within a scaled-up architecture. This work addresses the challenges of performing versatile computations on integrated photonic platforms, offering a promising solution for chip-integrated multifunctional photonic information processing.
data.title_cn: 可重构多功能集成光子计算芯片
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 随着信息技术的快速发展，人工智能和大规模模型展现出卓越的性能和广泛的应用。光子硬件提供了一种有前途的解决方案，可以满足对计算能力和能源效率日益增长的需求。研究人员的目标是开发一种高效的集成光子计算芯片，能够支持静态和动态时域的广泛应用场景。然而，在几种主流光子器件已经成熟的情况下，在基础计算单元层面实现根本性突破仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种新颖的算法-硬件协同设计策略，该策略能够在统一的光子配置内跨不同的神经网络模型进行原位可重构性。我们解锁了紧凑型交叉波导耦合微环组件的内在功能，以原生支持静态和动态时间任务。作为概念验证，我们在光子计算平台上实验性地集成了交钥匙孤子微梳作为光源，展示了在统一结构内实现全连接、卷积和循环神经网络模型。该芯片针对 208 个可调谐组件实现了高达 2.45 TOPS/mm 2 的面积计算效率。我们通过在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 数据集上执行图像分类任务来评估所提出芯片的性能，测得的测试准确率分别为 92.93% 和 56.57%。 IMDB 数据集上的情感分析实测测试准确率为 80.81%。此外，语音识别是通过在扩展架构中组合三个神经网络来实现的。这项工作解决了在集成光子平台上执行多功能计算的挑战，为芯片集成多功能光子信息处理提供了一种有前途的解决方案。

data.title: SiC diffractive waveguides for augmented reality: single-layer, full-color, rainbow-artifact-free display with vision correction
data.author: Boqu Chen, Ce Li, Xiaoxuan Li, Chenting Fang, Yinggang Chen, Ding Zhao, Lu Cai, Kaikai Du, Min Qiu
data.summary: Abstract The speed, dimensions, and immersive quality of communication have been continuously transformed by advances in information technology: from letters to telegraphs, telephones to video calls, and on-screen display to augmented reality (AR) displays. However, as demands for functional integration and high display quality intensify, significant limitations are encountered by conventional high-refractive-index glass-based diffractive waveguides, including bulkiness, weight, and rainbow artifacts in full-color displays. To overcome these challenges, we developed ultra-thin and ultra-light diffractive waveguides using 4H silicon carbide (SiC). These monolithic SiC waveguides are mass-produced via a specialized nanoimprinting (NIL) process on SiC wafers, leveraging the material’s high refractive index, thermal conductivity, and hardness. The resulting single-layer SiC waveguide achieves rainbow-artifact-free full-color displays while weighing just 3.795 g and measuring only 0.75 mm thick. Furthermore, we demonstrate compatibility with mass-produced prescription Fresnel lenses, addressing critical needs for myopia correction. This work advances diffractive waveguide display technology and offers a promising path for the future of information interaction.
data.title_cn: 用于增强现实的 SiC 衍射波导：具有视力矫正功能的单层、全彩、无彩虹伪影显示器
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 信息技术的进步不断改变着通信的速度、维度和沉浸式质量：从信件到电报，从电话到视频通话，从屏幕显示到增强现实 (AR) 显示。然而，随着对功能集成和高显示质量的需求不断增强，传统的基于高折射率玻璃的衍射波导遇到了重大限制，包括全彩显示器中的笨重、重量和彩虹伪影。为了克服这些挑战，我们使用 4H 碳化硅 (SiC) 开发了超薄超轻衍射波导。这些单片 SiC 波导是通过 SiC 晶圆上的专门纳米压印 (NIL) 工艺进行批量生产，利用了该材料的高折射率、导热性和硬度。由此产生的单层 SiC 波导可实现无彩虹伪影的全彩显示，同时重量仅为 3.795 克，厚度仅为 0.75 毫米。此外，我们还展示了与批量生产的处方菲涅尔镜片的兼容性，满足了近视矫正的关键需求。这项工作推进了衍射波导显示技术，并为信息交互的未来提供了一条有希望的道路。

data.title: Biomimetic acoustic perception via chip-scale dual-soliton microcombs
data.author: Teng Tan, Xin-Yue He, Bing Chang, Xu-Han Guo, Heng Zhou, Yong Geng, Yu Wu, Yu-Pei Liang, Ze-Ping Wang, Yong-Jun Huang, Ying-Zhan Yan, Si-Qin Ge, Yi-Kai Su, Chee Wei Wong, Bai-Cheng Yao
data.summary: Abstract Acoustic perception is a fairly basic but extraordinary feature in nature, relying on multidimensional signal processing for detection, localization, and recognition. Replicating this capability in compact artificial systems, however, remains a formidable challenge due to limitations in scalability, sensitivity, and integration. Here, imitating the auditory system of insects, we introduce an opto-acoustic perception paradigm using fully-stabilized dual-soliton microcombs. By integrating digitally stabilized on-chip dual-microcombs, silicon optoelectronics and bionic fiber-microphone arrays on a single platform, we achieve parallelized interrogation of over 100 sensors. Leveraging the low-noise, multi-channel coherence of fully-stabilized soliton microcombs, this synergy enables ultra-sensitive detection of 29.3 nPa/Hz 1/2 , sub centimeter precise localization, real-time tracking and identification for versatile acoustic targets. Bridging silicon photonics, optical fiber sensing and intelligent signal processing in a chiplet microsystem, our scheme delivers out-of-lab deployable capability on autonomous robotics. This work not only deepens the understanding of frequency comb science, but also establishes a concept of dual-comb-driven sensor networks as a scalable foundation for next-generation opto-acoustic intelligence.
data.title_cn: 通过芯片级双孤子微梳实现仿生声感知
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 声学感知是自然界中一个相当基本但非凡的特征，它依赖于多维信号处理来进行检测、定位和识别。然而，由于可扩展性、灵敏度和集成方面的限制，在紧凑的人工系统中复制这种能力仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们模仿昆虫的听觉系统，引入了一种使用完全稳定的双孤子微梳的光声感知范例。通过将数字稳定片上双微梳、硅光电器件和仿生光纤麦克风阵列集成在一个平台上，我们实现了 100 多个传感器的并行询问。利用完全稳定的孤子微梳的低噪声、多通道相干性，这种协同作用可以实现 29.3 nPa/Hz 1/2 的超灵敏检测、亚厘米级精确定位、实时跟踪和识别多种声学目标。我们的方案在小芯片微系统中桥接硅光子学、光纤传感和智能信号处理，为自主机器人提供实验室外可部署功能。这项工作不仅加深了对频率梳科学的理解，而且建立了双梳驱动传感器网络的概念，作为下一代光声智能的可扩展基础。

data.title: Reconstructive spectrometers: hardware miniaturization and computational reconstruction
data.author: Yiru Zhang, Enbo Yang, Hoon Hahn Yoon, Qixiang Cheng, Zhipei Sun, Tawfique Hasan, Weiwei Cai
data.summary: Abstract Spectrometers serve as indispensable analytical tools across chemistry, materials science, environmental monitoring, medical diagnostics, and beyond. The emergence of reconstructive spectrometers represents a transformative leap in spectral analysis, combining miniaturized encoding hardware with advanced computational algorithms to revolutionize conventional approaches. These devices encode unknown spectral data into measurable signals, for which sophisticated algorithms then decode to reconstruct the original spectrum with high fidelity—all achieved within an ultra-compact footprint. In this review, we first establish the mathematical foundations governing spectral encoding and decoding. We then provide a detailed analysis of encoding strategy and state-of-the-art decoding techniques, followed by recent breakthroughs in hardware design for optimized spectral reconstruction systems. Finally, we address key challenges and future opportunities, offering insights into how reconstructive spectrometers may redefine spectroscopy beyond traditional laboratory settings.
data.title_cn: 重建光谱仪：硬件小型化和计算重建
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 光谱仪是化学、材料科学、环境监测、医学诊断等领域不可或缺的分析工具。重建光谱仪的出现代表了光谱分析的一次变革性飞跃，它将小型化编码硬件与先进的计算算法相结合，彻底改变了传统方法。这些设备将未知的光谱数据编码为可测量的信号，然后通过复杂的算法进行解码，以高保真度重建原始光谱——所有这些都在超紧凑的占地面积内实现。在这篇综述中，我们首先建立了控制频谱编码和解码的数学基础。然后，我们对编码策略和最先进的解码技术进行详细分析，然后介绍优化光谱重建系统的硬件设计的最新突破。最后，我们解决了关键挑战和未来机遇，深入了解重建光谱仪如何超越传统实验室设置重新定义光谱学。

data.title: Research highlight: breaking the shot noise limit of mid-infrared dual-comb spectroscopy using intensity-difference squeezing
data.author: Guanhao Wu, Haoyang Yu
data.summary: Abstract Correlated twin combs generated by seeded four-wave mixing enable quantum correlation-enhanced dual-comb spectroscopy. High signal-to-noise ratio and comb-line-resolvable spectra in the mid-infrared molecular fingerprinting region is achieved by bridging intensity-difference squeezing and dual-comb spectroscopy.
data.title_cn: 研究亮点：利用强度差压缩突破中红外双梳光谱散粒噪声极限
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：由种子四波混频产生的相关双梳可实现量子相关增强双梳光谱。通过桥接强度差压缩和双梳光谱，实现中红外分子指纹识别区域的高信噪比和梳线可分辨光谱。

data.title: Research highlight: single photon Skyrmions from on-chip quantum dots
data.author: Mingjian Cheng, Andrew Forbes
data.summary: Abstract Optical Skyrmions have been demonstrated in many forms, but single photon Skyrmions have remained elusive. Now they are reported from nano-structured emitters, heralding quantum topologies on-chip.
data.title_cn: 研究亮点：来自片上量子点的单光子斯格明子
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 光学斯格明子已经以多种形式被证明，但单光子斯格明子仍然难以捉摸。现在，它们是从纳米结构发射器中报道出来的，预示着芯片上的量子拓扑。

data.title: Structured light meets machine intelligence
data.author: Zilong Zhang, Lingyu Kong, Lianghaoyue Zhang, Xiangyang Pan, Trishita Das, Benquan Wang, Baolei Liu, Fan Wang, Isaac Nape, Yijie Shen, Andrew Forbes
data.summary: Abstract Structured light, where light is tailored in all its degrees of freedom, has shown tremendous power in unlocking new modalities of light, with its impact felt across dimensions, disciplines, and applications. This richly textured light comes with deeply embedded complexity, making the design, analysis, and recognition of such complex light patterns highly non-trivial. In recent years artificial intelligence (AI) has come to the fore, offering innovative approaches and tools beyond the purely optical domain, not only for the design, characterization, and optimization of structured light but also for increasingly important roles in adding new functionalities and breaking old paradigms. An exciting twist is the flip side of the coin, where complex light in complex media acts as a light-speed neural network, ushering in a new era of ultrafast optical-based “machines” for intelligence and learning. In this review, we highlight how AI has enhanced structured light technologies, and vice versa, touching on imaging, microscopy, sensing, communication, and optical neural networks as topical application areas, while covering scales from the macroscopic to the microscopic, and from classical to quantum. We highlight the symbiotic relationship between intelligence and light in these processes and offer a perspective on the open challenges and future prospects of this emerging research direction.
data.title_cn: 结构光遇见机器智能
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 结构光在所有自由度上都进行了定制，在解锁新的光模式方面显示出了巨大的力量，其影响跨维度、学科和应用。这种纹理丰富的光具有深深嵌入的复杂性，使得此类复杂光图案的设计、分析和识别变得非常重要。近年来，人工智能 (AI) 脱颖而出，提供了超越纯光学领域的创新方法和工具，不仅用于结构光的设计、表征和优化，而且在添加新功能和打破旧范式方面发挥着越来越重要的作用。硬币的另一面令人兴奋，复杂介质中的复杂光充当光速神经网络，开创了基于超快光学“机器”的智能和学习新时代。在这篇综述中，我们重点介绍人工智能如何增强结构光技术，反之亦然，涉及成像、显微镜、传感、通信和光学神经网络等热门应用领域，同时涵盖从宏观到微观、从经典到量子的尺度。我们强调了这些过程中智能与光之间的共生关系，并就这一新兴研究方向的开放挑战和未来前景提供了视角。

data.title: Singulonics: narwhal-shaped wavefunctions for sub-diffraction-limited nanophotonics and imaging
data.author: Wen-Zhi Mao, Hong-Yi Luan, Ren-Min Ma
data.summary: Abstract The diffraction limit, rooted in the wave nature of light and formalized by the Heisenberg uncertainty principle, imposes a fundamental constraint on optical resolution and device miniaturization. The recent discovery of the singular dispersion equation in dielectric media provides a rigorous, lossless framework for overcoming this barrier. Here, we demonstrate that achieving such confinement necessarily involves a new class of optical eigenmodes—narwhal-shaped wavefunctions—which emerge from the singular dispersion equation and uniquely combine global Gaussian decay with local power-law enhancement. These wavefunctions enable full-space field localization beyond conventional limits. Guided by this principle, we design and experimentally realize a three-dimensional sub-diffraction-limited cavity that supports narwhal-shaped wavefunctions, achieving an ultrasmall mode volume of 5 × 10 −7 λ 3 . We term this class of systems singulonic, and define the emerging field of singulonics as a new nanophotonic paradigm—establishing a platform for confining and manipulating light at deep-subwavelength scales without dissipation, enabled by the singular dispersion equation. Building on this extreme confinement, we introduce singular field microscopy: a near-field imaging technique that employs singulonic eigenmodes as intrinsically localized, background-free light sources. This enables optical imaging at a spatial resolution of λ /1000, making atomic-scale optical microscopy possible. Our findings open new frontiers for unprecedented control over light–matter interactions at the smallest possible scales.
data.title_cn: 奇异学：用于亚衍射限制纳米光子学和成像的独角鲸形波函数
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 衍射极限植根于光的波动性，并由海森堡测不准原理形式化，对光学分辨率和器件小型化产生了根本性的限制。最近发现的介电介质奇异色散方程为克服这一障碍提供了严格、无损的框架。在这里，我们证明，实现这种限制必然涉及一类新的光学本征模——独角鲸形波函数——它从奇异色散方程中出现，并将全局高斯衰减与局部幂律增强独特地结合起来。这些波函数能够实现超出传统限制的全空间场定位。在此原理的指导下，我们设计并实验实现了支持独角鲸形波函数的三维亚衍射极限腔，实现了5 × 10 -7 λ 3 的超小模式体积。我们将这类系统称为奇异学，并将新兴的奇异学领域定义为一种新的纳米光子范式——建立一个平台，通过奇异色散方程实现在深亚波长范围内限制和操纵光而不耗散。在这种极端限制的基础上，我们引入了奇异场显微镜：一种近场成像技术，采用奇异本征模作为本质上局部的、无背景的光源。这使得光学成像的空间分辨率可达 λ/1000，从而使原子级光学显微镜成为可能。我们的研究结果为在尽可能最小的尺度上前所未有地控制光与物质相互作用开辟了新的领域。

data.title: High-throughput optical neuromorphic graphic processing at millions of images per second
data.author: Yibo Dong, Yuchi Bai, Qiming Zhang, Haitao Luan, Min Gu
data.summary: Abstract Optical diffractive neural networks (DNNs) offer superb parallelism and scalability for the direct analogue processing of planar information. However, their complete reliance on coherent light interference constrains the integration and computational frequency, as well as demonstrating low diffraction efficiency and robustness. Here, we present an optical graphics processing unit (OGPU) with a vertically integrated architecture, addressing these challenges through the use of an addressable vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) array. This array functions as a high-speed planar information fan-in device, with each unit exhibiting individually coherent and mutually incoherent (MI) properties. We develop MI-DNNs that leverage the direct operations of spatially incoherent light while preserving the benefits of coherent computing. Therefore, the entire computing system with free-space architecture can be miniaturized to a handheld form factor. The OGPU operates efficiently under ultralow-light conditions (as low as 3.52 aJ/μm 2 per frame) and achieves a record image processing speed of 25 million frames per second. The OGPU has a computational power of 77.3 tera-operations per second (TOPS) and an energy efficiency of 950 TOPS/W. The OPGU achieves competitive image classification accuracy of up to 98.6% and serves as versatile parallel convolutional kernels for image processing tasks, including edge extraction and image denoising.
data.title_cn: 每秒数百万张图像的高通量光学神经形态图形处理
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 光学衍射神经网络 (DNN) 为平面信息的直接模拟处理提供了卓越的并行性和可扩展性。然而，它们完全依赖相干光干涉，限制了集成和计算频率，并且衍射效率和鲁棒性较低。在这里，我们提出了一种具有垂直集成架构的光学图形处理单元（OGPU），通过使用可寻址垂直腔表面发射激光器（VCSEL）阵列来解决这些挑战。该阵列充当高速平面信息扇入设备，每个单元都表现出单独相干和相互不相干（MI）特性。我们开发的 MI-DNN 利用空间不相干光的直接运算，同时保留相干计算的优势。因此，具有自由空间架构的整个计算系统可以小型化至手持式外形。 OGPU可在超低光照条件下高效运行（每帧低至3.52 aJ/μm 2 ），并实现每秒2500万帧的创纪录图像处理速度。 OGPU 的计算能力为每秒 77.3 兆次运算 (TOPS)，能效为 950 TOPS/W。 OPGU 实现了高达 98.6% 的竞争性图像分类精度，并可用作图像处理任务（包括边缘提取和图像去噪）的多功能并行卷积核。

data.title: Research highlight: how to cage a unicorn—confining light in a tiny volume
data.author: Jacob B. Khurgin
data.summary: Abstract Overcoming the diffraction limit in optics is challenging and demands a profound understanding of light behavior under extreme confinement. The newly developed framework, termed singulonics, demonstrates the formation of sub-diffraction limit narwhal-shaped optical modes under specific conditions. Experimental implementation of this field confinement within a tiny sub-wavelength volume enables the acquisition of near-field super resolution images.
data.title_cn: 研究亮点：如何关住独角兽——将光线限制在微小的体积内
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 克服光学衍射极限具有挑战性，需要对极端限制下的光行为有深刻的理解。新开发的框架被称为奇异学，展示了在特定条件下亚衍射极限独角鲸形光学模式的形成。在微小的亚波长体积内实验实现这种场限制能够获取近场超分辨率图像。

data.title: Massively parallel and universal approximation of nonlinear functions using diffractive processors
data.author: Md Sadman Sakib Rahman, Yuhang Li, Xilin Yang, Shiqi Chen, Aydogan Ozcan
data.summary: Abstract Nonlinear computation is essential for a wide range of information processing tasks, yet implementing nonlinear functions using optical systems remains a challenge due to the weak and power-intensive nature of optical nonlinearities. Overcoming this limitation without relying on nonlinear optical materials could unlock unprecedented opportunities for ultrafast and parallel optical computing systems. Here, we demonstrate that large-scale nonlinear computation can be performed using linear optics through optimized diffractive processors composed of passive phase-only surfaces. In this framework, the input variables of nonlinear functions are encoded into the phase of an optical wavefront—e.g., via a spatial light modulator (SLM)—and transformed by an optimized diffractive structure with spatially varying point-spread functions to yield output intensities that approximate a large set of unique nonlinear functions–all in parallel. We provide proof establishing that this architecture serves as a universal function approximator for an arbitrary set of bandlimited nonlinear functions, also covering wavelength-multiplexed nonlinear functions as well as multi-variate and complex-valued functions that are all-optically cascadable. Our analysis also indicates the successful approximation of typical nonlinear activation functions commonly used in neural networks, including the sigmoid, tanh, ReLU (rectified linear unit), and softplus. We numerically demonstrate the parallel computation of one million distinct nonlinear functions, accurately executed at wavelength-scale spatial density at the output of a diffractive optical processor. Furthermore, we experimentally validated this framework using in situ optical learning and approximated 35 unique nonlinear functions in a single shot using a compact setup consisting of an SLM and an image sensor. These results establish diffractive optical processors as a scalable platform for massively parallel universal nonlinear function approximation, paving the way for new capabilities in analog optical computing based on linear materials.
data.title_cn: 使用衍射处理器的非线性函数的大规模并行和通用逼近
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 非线性计算对于广泛的信息处理任务至关重要，但由于光学非线性的弱和功耗密集的性质，使用光学系统实现非线性函数仍然是一个挑战。在不依赖非线性光学材料的情况下克服这一限制可以为超快并行光学计算系统带来前所未有的机遇。在这里，我们证明可以使用线性光学通过由无源纯相位表面组成的优化衍射处理器来执行大规模非线性计算。在此框架中，非线性函数的输入变量被编码到光学波前的相位中（例如，通过空间光调制器（SLM）），并通过具有空间变化点扩散函数的优化衍射结构进行转换，以产生近似于大量独特非线性函数的输出强度，所有这些都是并行的。我们提供的证据表明，该架构可作为任意一组带限非线性函数的通用函数逼近器，还涵盖波长复用非线性函数以及全光学级联的多元和复值函数。我们的分析还表明，神经网络中常用的典型非线性激活函数的成功逼近，包括 sigmoid、tanh、ReLU（修正线性单元）和 softplus。我们以数值方式演示了一百万个不同非线性函数的并行计算，这些计算在衍射光学处理器的输出处以波长级空间密度精确执行。此外，我们使用原位光学学习对这个框架进行了实验验证，并使用由 SLM 和图像传感器组成的紧凑设置在单次拍摄中近似了 35 个独特的非线性函数。这些结果将衍射光学处理器确立为大规模并行通用非线性函数逼近的可扩展平台，为基于线性材料的模拟光学计算的新功能铺平了道路。

data.title: Neural array meta-imaging
data.author: Xiong Dun, Jian Zhang, Fansheng Chen, Zhanyi Zhang, Xuquan Wang, Yujie Xing, Siyu Dong, Zeying Fan, Yuzhi Shi, Wetzstein Gordon, Zhanshan Wang, Xinbin Cheng
data.summary: Abstract Compact, high-quality imaging systems are highly desired for scientific, industrial, and consumer applications. Metalenses combined with computational imaging offer a promising solution for developing such systems, yet their performance is fundamentally limited by the commonly used point-to-point imaging model, which forces trade-offs between aperture size, F-number, field of view (FOV), waveband width, and image quality. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that a neural array imaging model can overcome these long-standing trade-offs, achieving a 25-Hz full-color imaging camera with a 2.76-mm aperture, 1.45 F-number, 50 $$^{\circ }$$ ∘ FOV, and a spectral range of 400–700 nm. The camera achieves image quality comparable to commercial compound lenses (e.g., Edmund 33-300) in both indoor and outdoor environments, while reducing the total track length by a factor of 13. We further demonstrate its suitability for object detection and depth estimation in real-world scenarios. This neural array imaging model is also applied to polarization imaging, showcasing its scalability and versatility for broadband applications.
data.title_cn: 神经阵列元成像
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 科学、工业和消费应用非常需要紧凑、高质量的成像系统。超透镜与计算成像相结合，为开发此类系统提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但其性能从根本上受到常用的点对点成像模型的限制，该模型迫使在孔径尺寸、F数、视场 (FOV)、波段宽度和图像质量之间进行权衡。在这里，我们通过实验证明神经阵列成像模型可以克服这些长期存在的权衡，实现具有 2.76 毫米孔径、1.45 F 数、50 $$^{\circ }$$ ∘ FOV 和 400–700 nm 光谱范围的 25 Hz 全彩成像相机。该相机在室内和室外环境下都能实现与商业复合镜头（例如 Edmund 33-300）相当的图像质量，同时将总轨迹长度减少 13 倍。我们进一步证明了其在现实场景中的物体检测和深度估计的适用性。这种神经阵列成像模型也应用于偏振成像，展示了其宽带应用的可扩展性和多功能性。

data.title: Research highlight: new and powerful approach to wide-field fluorescence lifetime imaging with single-molecule sensitivity
data.author: Jörg Enderlein
data.summary: Abstract Historically constrained by the low throughput of traditional Time-Correlated Single-Photon Counting (TCSPC), a new method utilizes an optimized, time-gated single-photon camera acquisition scheme for achieving single-molecule lifetime precision comparable to TCSPC, but across a wide field of view simultaneously. This high-throughput capability transforms single-molecule FLIM from a specialized, time-consuming effort into a scalable, quantitative assay. The resulting multimodal imaging platform provides unprecedented simultaneous insight into the nanoscale location (SMLM) and local environment (FLIM) of biological molecules, advancing our ability to map complex biophysical parameters like FRET efficiency in living systems.
data.title_cn: 研究亮点：具有单分子灵敏度的宽视场荧光寿命成像的新而强大的方法
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 过去，由于传统时间相关单光子计数 (TCSPC) 的低通量的限制，一种新方法利用优化的时间选通单光子相机采集方案来实现与 TCSPC 相当的单分子寿命精度，但同时跨宽视场。这种高通量能力将单分子 FLIM 从专门的、耗时的工作转变为可扩展的定量分析。由此产生的多模态成像平台提供了对生物分子的纳米级位置 (SMLM) 和局部环境 (FLIM) 前所未有的同步洞察，提高了我们绘制复杂生物物理参数（例如生命系统中的 FRET 效率）的能力。

data.title: Deep-ultraviolet ptychographic pocket-scope (DART): mesoscale lensless molecular imaging with label-free spectroscopic contrast
data.author: Ruihai Wang, Qianhao Zhao, Julia Quinn, Liming Yang, Yuhui Zhu, Feifei Huang, Chengfei Guo, Tianbo Wang, Pengming Song, Michael Murphy, Thanh D. Nguyen, Andrew Maiden, Francisco E. Robles, Guoan Zheng
data.summary: Abstract The mesoscale characterization of biological specimens has traditionally required compromises between resolution, field-of-view, depth-of-field, and molecular specificity, with most approaches relying on external labels. Here we present the Deep-ultrAviolet ptychogRaphic pockeT-scope (DART), a handheld platform that transforms label-free molecular imaging through intrinsic deep-ultraviolet spectroscopic contrast. By leveraging biomolecules’ natural absorption fingerprints and combining them with lensless ptychographic microscopy, DART resolves down to 308-nm linewidths across centimeter-scale areas while maintaining millimeter-scale depth-of-field. The system’s virtual error-bin methodology effectively eliminates artifacts from limited temporal coherence and other optical imperfections, enabling high-fidelity molecular imaging without lenses. Through differential spectroscopic imaging at deep-ultraviolet wavelengths, DART quantitatively maps nucleic acid and protein distributions with femtogram sensitivity, providing an intrinsic basis for explainable virtual staining. We demonstrate DART’s capabilities through imaging of tissue sections, cytopathology specimens, blood cells, and neural populations, revealing detailed molecular contrast without external labels. The combination of high-resolution molecular mapping and broad mesoscale imaging in a portable platform opens new possibilities from rapid clinical diagnostics, tissue analysis, to biological characterization in space exploration.
data.title_cn: 深紫外折叠袖珍镜 (DART)：具有无标记光谱对比度的中尺度无透镜分子成像
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 生物样本的介观表征传统上需要在分辨率、视场、景深和分子特异性之间进行折衷，大多数方法依赖于外部标签。在这里，我们展示了深紫外ptychogRaphic pockeT-scope (DART)，这是一种手持式平台，可通过内在的深紫外光谱对比度转换无标记分子成像。通过利用生物分子的自然吸收指纹并将其与无透镜叠层显微镜相结合，DART 可在厘米级区域解析低至 308 纳米的线宽，同时保持毫米级景深。该系统的虚拟误差箱方法有效地消除了有限时间相干性和其他光学缺陷造成的伪影，从而无需镜头即可实现高保真分子成像。通过深紫外波长的差分光谱成像，DART 以飞克级灵敏度定量绘制核酸和蛋白质分布图，为可解释的虚拟染色提供内在基础。我们通过组织切片、细胞病理学标本、血细胞和神经群的成像来展示 DART 的功能，无需外部标记即可显示详细的分子对比。便携式平台中高分辨率分子图谱和宽介观成像的结合开辟了从快速临床诊断、组织分析到空间探索中的生物表征的新可能性。

data.title: Hidden multi-topological phases mediated by constrained inter-cell coupling
data.author: Ziteng Wang, Domenico Bongiovanni, Xiangdong Wang, Zhichan Hu, Dario Jukić, Daohong Song, Jingjun Xu, Roberto Morandotti, Zhigang Chen, Hrvoje Buljan
data.summary: Abstract The discovery of topological phases of matter and topological boundary states had a tremendous impact on condensed matter physics, photonics, and material sciences, where topological phases are defined via energy bands, described by the topological band theory. However, there are topological materials that cannot be described by this theory, which support non-trivial boundary states but are little-known and largely unexplored. Here, we uncover a new class of topological phases—termed "multi-topological phase" (MTPs)—arising from constrained inter-cell coupling in lattice systems, and experimentally demonstrate them in a photonic platform. The MTP features multiple sets of boundary states, where each set is associated with one distinct topological invariant. Unlike conventional topological phases, the MTP cannot be identified via the original band structure, being a "hidden" topological phase, where the phase transition can occur without band-gap closing. We present typical examples of MTPs in both one- and two-dimensional structures, as well as in indirectly gapped Chern insulators, beyond the regime where the conventional bulk-boundary correspondence predicts the existence of boundary states. Furthermore, we directly observe the MTPs in the first two examples using laser-written photonic lattices. Our work offers a new design strategy for topological materials, paving the way for future exploration and applications in photonics.
data.title_cn: 由受限细胞间耦合介导的隐藏多拓扑相
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 物质拓扑相和拓扑边界态的发现对凝聚态物理、光子学和材料科学产生了巨大影响，其中拓扑相是通过拓扑带理论描述的能带来定义的。然而，有些拓扑材料无法用该理论描述，它们支持非平凡的边界态，但鲜为人知且很大程度上未经探索。在这里，我们发现了一类新的拓扑相——称为“多拓扑相”（MTP）——由晶格系统中的受限细胞间耦合产生，并在光子平台中通过实验证明了它们。 MTP 具有多组边界状态，其中每组都与一个不同的拓扑不变量相关联。与传统的拓扑相不同，MTP 不能通过原始的能带结构来识别，它是一种“隐藏”的拓扑相，其中相变可以在带隙闭合的情况下发生。我们提出了一维和二维结构以及间接有隙陈绝缘体中 MTP 的典型例子，超出了传统体边界对应预测边界态存在的范围。此外，我们使用激光写入光子晶格直接观察前两个示例中的 MTP。我们的工作为拓扑材料提供了一种新的设计策略，为未来光子学的探索和应用铺平了道路。

data.title: State transfer in latent-symmetric networks
data.author: Jonas Himmel, Max Ehrhardt, Matthias Heinrich, Sebastian Weidemann, Tom A. W. Wolterink, Malte Röntgen, Peter Schmelcher, Alexander Szameit
data.summary: Abstract The transport of quantum states is a crucial aspect of information processing systems, facilitating operations such as quantum key distribution and inter-component communication within quantum computers. Most quantum networks rely on symmetries to achieve an efficient state transfer. A straightforward way to design such networks is to use spatial symmetries, which severely limits the design space. Our work takes a novel approach to designing photonic networks that do not exhibit any conventional spatial symmetries, yet nevertheless support an efficient transfer of quantum states. Paradoxically, while a perfect transfer efficiency is technically unattainable in these networks, a fidelity arbitrarily close to unity is always reached within a finite time of evolution. Key to this approach are so-called latent, or 'hidden', symmetries, which are embodied in the spectral properties of the network. Latent symmetries substantially expand the design space of quantum networks and hold significant potential for applications in quantum cryptography and secure state transfer. We experimentally realize such a nine-site latent-symmetric network and successfully observe state transfer between two sites with a measured fidelity of 75%. Furthermore, by launching a two-photon state, we show that quantum interference is preserved by the network. This demonstrates that the latent symmetries enable efficient quantum state transfer, while offering greater flexibility in designing quantum networks.
data.title_cn: 潜在对称网络中的状态转移
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 量子态的传输是信息处理系统的一个重要方面，促进量子计算机内的量子密钥分发和组件间通信等操作。大多数量子网络依靠对称性来实现有效的状态转移。设计此类网络的一种直接方法是使用空间对称性，这严重限制了设计空间。我们的工作采用了一种新颖的方法来设计光子网络，该网络不表现出任何传统的空间对称性，但仍然支持量子态的有效转移。矛盾的是，虽然这些网络在技术上无法实现完美的传输效率，但在有限的进化时间内总是可以达到任意接近统一的保真度。这种方法的关键是所谓的潜在或“隐藏”对称性，它们体现在网络的光谱特性中。潜在对称性极大地扩展了量子网络的设计空间，并在量子密码学和安全状态转移方面具有巨大的应用潜力。我们通过实验实现了这样一个九站点潜在对称网络，并成功观察了两个站点之间的状态转移，测量保真度为 75%。此外，通过发射双光子态，我们表明网络保留了量子干涉。这表明潜在对称性可以实现有效的量子状态转移，同时为设计量子网络提供更大的灵活性。

data.title: Nonlinear nonlocal metasurfaces
data.author: Michele Cotrufo, Luca Carletti, Adam Overvig, Andrea Alù
data.summary: Abstract Nonlinear metasurfaces have been enabling unprecedented control over light generation and wave mixing, demonstrating enhanced wavefront control, beam shaping and steering of nonlinear light waves. However, the design and operation of nonlinear metasurfaces have been for the most part limited to localized modes, fundamentally limiting the overall nonlinearity enhancement of such devices. Periodic structures supporting extended lattice resonances can realize much larger quality-factor resonances, and hence stronger nonlinearity enhancement, but they are fundamentally limited in their wavefront shaping capabilities, due to their high symmetry. Nonlocal metasurfaces have been recently introduced in linear settings to support highly delocalized resonant modes that can promote very large quality factors, yet without requiring periodicity, hence providing also local control over the wavefront. Here, we extend the powerful features of nonlocal metasurfaces to nonlinear phenomena, experimentally demonstrating nonlinear nonlocal metasurfaces that simultaneously support high quality factor modes, and hence strong nonlinearity enhancement, as well as a spatially varying geometric phase tailored over a subwavelength scale. We show how nonlinear nonlocal metasurfaces can at the same time enhance light-matter interactions, boosting nonlinear conversion efficiency, and enable precise subwavelength control over the wavefront of the generated light. Using this platform, we demonstrate a silicon metasurface for beam steering of third-harmonic generation in the visible. Our results show control over the polarization and steering angle of the third-harmonic signal, extending the framework of diffractive nonlocal metasurfaces to nonlinear optics, and pave the way for the development of nanoscale nonlinear devices with unparalleled control over the optical properties of generated light.
data.title_cn: 非线性非局部超表面
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 非线性超表面已经能够实现对光产生和波混合的前所未有的控制，展示了增强的波前控制、光束整形和非线性光波的转向。然而，非线性超表面的设计和操作在很大程度上仅限于局部模式，从根本上限制了此类设备的整体非线性增强。支持扩展晶格谐振的周期性结构可以实现更大的品质因数谐振，从而实现更强的非线性增强，但由于其高对称性，它们的波前整形能力从根本上受到限制。最近在线性设置中引入了非局部超表面，以支持高度离域的谐振模式，该模式可以促进非常大的品质因数，但不需要周期性，因此还提供对波前的局部控制。在这里，我们将非局域超表面的强大功能扩展到非线性现象，通过实验证明非线性非局域超表面同时支持高质量因子模式，从而实现强大的非线性增强，以及在亚波长尺度上定制的空间变化的几何相位。我们展示了非线性非局域超表面如何同时增强光与物质的相互作用，提高非线性转换效率，并实现对所生成光的波前的精确亚波长控制。使用该平台，我们演示了用于可见光中三次谐波产生的光束控制的硅超表面。我们的结果显示了对三次谐波信号的偏振和转向角的控制，将衍射非局域超表面的框架扩展到非线性光学，并为开发对所产生的光的光学特性进行无与伦比的控制的纳米级非线性器件铺平了道路。

data.title: High-power hundred-nanosecond 532 nm laser employing a dual-rod configuration for cavity length extension and conjugate compensation
data.author: Shuai Zhou, Shouqian Liu, Junjie Yuan, Houwen Yang, Yuting Ouyang, Wenyong Cheng
data.summary: A nanosecond-long-pulse, high-beam-quality, high-power 532 nm laser was developed by employing two serially cascaded Nd:YAG modules with a 0.8% doping concentration, positioned at optically conjugate planes for thermal lens compensation. The laser employed single acousto-optic Q-switching to generate the fundamental pulsed output and intracavity second-harmonic generation (SHG) to obtain a 532 nm laser output. Through the integration of beam propagation theory and experimental validation, an optimized resonator configuration was devised. The laser produced an average output power of 85.24 W at 532 nm under a repetition rate of 14.5 kHz, corresponding to a second-harmonic conversion efficiency of 65.3%. The generated green pulses exhibited a pulse duration of 133.5 ns. The beam quality factors of the 532 nm laser were measured to be M x 2 =9.05 and M y 2 =9.29, respectively, while a root-mean-square (RMS) power fluctuation was 0.74% over 2 h. Subsequently, the stable 532 nm laser beam was coupled into an optical fiber with a core diameter of 200 µm and a numerical aperture (NA) of 0.06. This configuration yielded an average output power of 77.66 W, corresponding to a coupling efficiency of 91.1%.
data.title_cn: 采用双棒配置的高功率百纳秒 532 nm 激光器，用于腔长扩展和共轭补偿
data.abstract_cn: 采用两个串联级联的掺杂浓度为 0.8% 的 Nd:YAG 模块开发了纳秒长脉冲、高光束质量、高功率 532 nm 激光器，该模块位于光学共轭平面上以进行热透镜补偿。该激光器采用单声光调Q产生基波脉冲输出和腔内二次谐波产生（SHG）以获得532 nm激光输出。通过光束传播理论和实验验证的结合，设计了一种优化的谐振器配置。该激光器在 14.5 kHz 重复频率下在 532 nm 处产生的平均输出功率为 85.24 W，对应的二次谐波转换效率为 65.3%。生成的绿色脉冲的脉冲持续时间为 133.5 ns。测得532 nm激光器的光束质量因子分别为M x 2 =9.05和M y 2 =9.29，而2小时内的均方根（RMS）功率波动为0.74%。随后，稳定的 532 nm 激光束耦合到芯直径为 200 µm、数值孔径 (NA) 为 0.06 的光纤中。该配置产生的平均输出功率为 77.66 W，对应的耦合效率为 91.1%。

data.title: Non-destructive real-time monitoring of bolt preload in wind turbine towers using FBG sensors on the nut
data.author: Hanrui Yang, Fengling Li, Yong Han, Jianmin Yu, Hao Meng, Xun Lou
data.summary: Bolt loosening in wind turbine towers often causes structural failures, leading to annual economic losses exceeding 100 million yuan. To address limitations of traditional monitoring methods, this study proposes a non-destructive, real-time preload monitoring technique using fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors. A mechanical model and finite element analysis reveal a strong linear correlation ( R 2 >0.9996) between nut strain and applied torque. A dual-FBG differential compensation strategy effectively mitigates temperature–strain cross-coupling. The method demonstrates high accuracy and reliability, offering a feasible solution for structural health monitoring and early warning in wind turbine towers.
data.title_cn: 使用螺母上的 FBG 传感器对风力涡轮机塔架中的螺栓预紧力进行无损实时监测
data.abstract_cn: 风电塔筒螺栓松动常常造成结构性故障，每年造成的经济损失超过亿元。为了解决传统监测方法的局限性，本研究提出了一种使用光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）传感器的非破坏性实时预载监测技术。机械模型和有限元分析揭示了螺母应变和施加扭矩之间存在很强的线性相关性（R 2 >0.9996）。双 FBG 差分补偿策略有效减轻了温度应变交叉耦合。该方法具有较高的准确性和可靠性，为风力发电机塔架结构健康监测和预警提供了可行的解决方案。

data.title: Stress coefficient calibration from correlating longitudinal wave velocity and stress birefringence in ultra-low expansion quartz glass
data.author: Wenqing Wei, Zisheng Tang, Lingxin Kong, Lingxia Zhou, Yifan Zhu, Guojun Xia, Hu Deng, Hong Liu
data.summary: Ultra-low expansion quartz glass serves as a critical material for large-aperture telescope mirrors, yet its imaging quality and dimensional stability are often compromised by residual stresses generated during manufacturing. In response to this problem, we developed a stress coefficient calibration method that combines acoustoelastic and photoelastic effects, establishing a direct correlation between longitudinal wave velocity and stress birefringence. The feasibility and accuracy of the ultrasonic immersion pulse-echo method in capturing the acoustoelastic effect were verified through finite-element simulation, thereby laying a solid foundation for the subsequent experimental design. To realistically replicate the stress state during actual fabrication, we introduced a wide-range composite stress field in samples possessing intrinsic structural stresses through the quenching treatment. Experimental results reveal a clear linear relationship with R 2 ≥0.967 between longitudinal wave velocity and stress birefringence within a stress birefringence range of 0–40 nm/cm, yielding a stress coefficient of approximately −0.43884(m/s)/(nm/cm) with a standard deviation of 0.00965 (m/s)/(nm/cm). This method eliminates the need for complex mechanical loading and is both non-contact and non-destructive, thereby providing, to our knowledge, a new approach for the non-destructive testing of residual stress and the optimization of manufacturing processes in ultra-low expansion quartz glass.
data.title_cn: 通过关联超低膨胀石英玻璃中的纵波速度和应力双折射进行应力系数校准
data.abstract_cn: 超低膨胀石英玻璃是大口径望远镜镜面的关键材料，但其成像质量和尺寸稳定性往往受到制造过程中产生的残余应力的影响。针对这一问题，我们开发了一种结合声弹和光弹效应的应力系数标定方法，建立了纵波速度与应力双折射之间的直接相关性。通过有限元仿真验证了超声浸入式脉冲回波法捕捉声弹效应的可行性和准确性，为后续实验设计奠定了坚实的基础。为了真实地复制实际制造过程中的应力状态，我们通过淬火处理在具有内在结构应力的样品中引入了宽范围的复合应力场。实验结果表明，在应力双折射0~40 nm/cm范围内，纵波速度与应力双折射之间存在明显的线性关系，R 2 ≥0.967，应力系数约为-0.43884(m/s)/(nm/cm)，标准差为0.00965(m/s)/(nm/cm)。据我们所知，该方法无需复杂的机械加载，并且是非接触式和非破坏性的，从而为超低膨胀石英玻璃的残余应力无损测试和制造工艺优化提供了一种新方法。

data.title: Polar stratospheric clouds over the Alps
data.author: Claudia Hinz
data.summary: Polar stratospheric clouds (PSCs) typically form in polar regions at temperatures below −78 ∘ C, at altitudes of approximately 20–25 km. Such temperatures are normally not reached over the Alps, as the stratosphere at mid-latitudes generally remains warmer (−60 ∘ C to −70 ∘ C). The documented case, which, to our knowledge, is likely the first observation of PSCs over the Alps at a geographic latitude of 46–47° N, is examined. PSCs at such southern latitudes have neither been previously observed in Central Europe nor detected through satellite data analyses. This case is particularly notable not only for its geographic rarity but also because the nacreous clouds were detected in long-exposure webcam images under moonlight—a phenomenon that has not previously been documented in Central Europe.
data.title_cn: 阿尔卑斯山上空的极地平流层云
data.abstract_cn: 极地平流层云 (PSC) 通常在温度低于 -78 ∘ C、海拔约 20-25 公里的极地地区形成。阿尔卑斯山上空通常不会达到这样的温度，因为中纬度地区的平流层通常仍然较温暖（-60 ∘ C 至 -70 ∘ C）。据我们所知，记录在案的案例很可能是在阿尔卑斯山北纬 46-47° 地理纬度上空首次观测到 PSC。如此南纬地区的 PSC 以前既没有在中欧观测到，也没有通过卫星数据分析检测到。这一案例尤其引人注目，不仅因为其地理上的罕见性，还因为在月光下的长时间曝光网络摄像头图像中检测到了珠光云——这种现象以前在中欧从未有过记录。

data.title: Photothermal microtip with “nanotrap” on a fiber-optic end-face grating for specific sensing of inert gas Xe
data.author: Lingxin Kong, Wenyu Yan, Zhixin Gao, Feng Zhang, Cheng Ren, Shuai Feng, Dezhong Cao
data.summary: This study proposes a fiber-optic xenon (Xe) sensor with photothermally tunable gas concentration sensitivity (PTGCS). A polymer microtip doped with Xe-selective material MOF-1 and photothermal material MOF-2 on the single-mode fiber (SMF) end face acts as a Fabry–Pérot (FP) sensor for Xe gas detection. MOF-2 can control the temperature of the polymer microtip by adjusting the power of the 808 nm laser. Based on the adsorption law of MOF-1, we establish the “laser power/temperature—gas concentration—spectral response” model of the sensor. Meanwhile, an ultra-compact plasmonic grating embedded between the optical fiber core and the polymer microtip serves as the temperature indicator. The research results show that when the excitation power of the 808 nm laser is 5 mW (50 °C) and 10 mW (70 °C), the PTGCS values of the sensor are 0.191 nm/ppb and 0.106 nm/ppb, respectively. The ratio of the two PTGCS values is 1.8, which can serve as the identification parameter for Xe gas to distinguish it from other gases, particularly krypton (Kr) gas. This sensor overcomes the limitation of relying solely on the selectivity of sensitive materials to identify Xe and can self-adjust the temperature to resist temperature interference.
data.title_cn: 光纤端面光栅上带有“纳米陷阱”的光热微尖端，用于惰性气体 Xe 的特定传感
data.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种具有光热可调气体浓度灵敏度（PTGCS）的光纤氙（Xe）传感器。在单模光纤 (SMF) 端面上掺杂 Xe 选择性材料 MOF-1 和光热材料 MOF-2 的聚合物微尖充当用于 Xe 气体检测的法布里-珀罗 (FP) 传感器。 MOF-2可以通过调节808 nm激光的功率来控制聚合物微尖的温度。基于MOF-1的吸附定律，建立了传感器的“激光功率/温度-气体浓度-光谱响应”模型。同时，嵌入光纤芯和聚合物微尖之间的超紧凑等离子体光栅用作温度指示器。研究结果表明，当808 nm激光器的激发功率为5 mW（50℃）和10 mW（70℃）时，传感器的PTGCS值分别为0.191 nm/ppb和0.106 nm/ppb。两个PTGCS值的比值为1.8，可以作为氙气的识别参数，以将其与其他气体，特别是氪气（Kr）区分开来。该传感器克服了单纯依靠敏感材料的选择性来识别Xe的局限性，并且可以自我调节温度以抵抗温度干扰。

data.title: Reconfigurable exceptional points for enhanced sensitivity in a high-Q toroidal spoof localized surface plasmonic resonator
data.author: Yaoran Zhang, Yuxiang Cao, Hao Hu, Liangliang Liu, Yu Luo, Zhuo Li
data.summary: Exceptional points (EPs) occur in non-Hermitian systems when two or more eigenstates coalesce, resulting in degenerate eigenvalues and distinctive physical phenomena that deviate significantly from conventional frameworks. Such singularities have attracted extensive research interest due to their potential in asymmetric mode switching, nonreciprocal transmission, and ultrasensitive sensing applications. Nonetheless, the practical implementation of EP-based sensors faces challenges arising from inherent fabrication imperfections, causing deviations from ideal EP conditions in rigid structural designs. Moreover, weak field coupling often limits the ability to detect exceedingly subtle perturbations. In this Letter, we introduce a reconfigurable EP sensor employing a high quality-factor (Q-factor) toroidal spoof localized surface plasmonic resonator (TSLSPR) with a suspended configuration, enhancing the reconfigurability of EP states across multipolar plasmonic modes. By strategically positioning two dielectric scatterers, our proposed EP sensor demonstrates significantly amplified frequency splitting compared to conventional diabolic point (DP) sensors, achieving an exceptionally low detection limit of 0.0001λ (diameter of 0.01 mm) and a notably high Q-factor of up to 423. This work presents an innovative approach for advancing high-sensitivity detection technologies and may stimulate further research into novel EP-based photonic devices.
data.title_cn: 可重构的特殊点可增强高 Q 值环形欺骗局域表面等离子体谐振器的灵敏度
data.abstract_cn: 当两个或多个本征态合并时，非厄米系统中会出现异常点（EP），导致简并本征值和明显偏离传统框架的独特物理现象。这种奇点由于其在非对称模式切换、不可逆传输和超灵敏传感应用中的潜力而吸引了广泛的研究兴趣。尽管如此，基于 EP 的传感器的实际实施面临着固有制造缺陷带来的挑战，导致刚性结构设计中与理想 EP 条件的偏差。此外，弱场耦合通常会限制检测极其细微的扰动的能力。在这封信中，我们介绍了一种可重构的 EP 传感器，该传感器采用具有悬浮配置的高品质因数 (Q 因子) 环形欺骗局域表面等离子体谐振器 (TSLSPR)，从而增强了跨多极等离子体模式的 EP 状态的可重构性。通过战略性地定位两个介电散射体，我们提出的 EP 传感器与传统的恶魔点 ​​(DP) 传感器相比，表现出显着放大的频率分裂，实现了 0.0001λ（直径 0.01 mm）的极低检测限和高达 423 的极高 Q 因子。这项工作提出了一种推进高灵敏度检测技术的创新方法，并可能促进对基于 EP 的新型光子器件的进一步研究。

data.title: An efficient transient solver for photothermal properties of metallic nanostructures
data.author: Tiancheng Zhang, Shiyu Wang, Huaguang Bao, Zi He, Xuewen Chen, Wengwu Fang, Dazhi Ding
data.summary: This Letter focuses on a remarkable simulation tool for the photothermal properties of the metallic nanostructures. A fully coupled method is established based on Maxwell’s equations and the law of heat conduction in the time domain. This method is different from the conventional co-simulation scheme with a steady-state optical field and a transient thermal field, offering a more versatile approach for analyzing photothermal characteristics. To effectively evaluate the photothermal coupling effect, the discontinuous Galerkin technique is utilized. Furthermore, the time-scaling approach is introduced to address the multiscale nature of the temporal responses between the light and heat fields. Thus, an efficient numerical solver for the photothermal properties of metallic nanostructures is developed. Numerical examples demonstrate the remarkable accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method. Therefore, this approach can provide an essential theoretical tool for designing dynamically reconfigurable nano-devices.
data.title_cn: 金属纳米结构光热特性的高效瞬态求解器
data.abstract_cn: 这封信重点介绍了一种出色的金属纳米结构光热性能模拟工具。基于麦克斯韦方程组和时域热传导定律建立了全耦合方法。该方法不同于传统的稳态光场和瞬态热场联合仿真方案，为分析光热特性提供了更通用的方法。为了有效评估光热耦合效应，采用了不连续伽辽金技术。此外，引入时间尺度方法来解决光场和热场之间时间响应的多尺度性质。因此，开发了一种用于金属纳米结构光热性质的有效数值求解器。数值例子证明了该方法的显着准确性和效率。因此，这种方法可以为设计动态可重构纳米器件提供重要的理论工具。

data.title: A high-resolution coherent optical spectrum analyzer eliminating the mirror effect via Hilbert transform
data.author: Huafei Mao, Zhihang Lin, Zhipeng Wu, Xiao Liu, Qinggang Lin, Yanghui Li, Juan Kang, Le Wang, Yi Li
data.summary: Compared with traditional grating-based spectrometers, a coherent optical spectrum analyzer (COSA) can provide much higher resolution by converting optical spectral signals into electrical beat signals via heterodyne detection. However, the heterodyning process produces two symmetric sideband peaks for each spectral component, i.e., the mirror effect, which fundamentally limits the resolution. To overcome this constraint, we introduce an instantaneous frequency masking algorithm to eliminate the mirror effect in this study. Experimental results demonstrate a spectral resolution of 2 MHz using the same hardware previously limited to 6 MHz. Furthermore, a compact silicon-photonic wavelength reference for sweep linearization is utilized in the system, achieving long-term wavelength accuracy of ±0.1 pm. The proposed method establishes a cost-effective new paradigm for surpassing the inherent resolution limits of COSA.
data.title_cn: 通过希尔伯特变换消除镜面效应的高分辨率相干光谱分析仪
data.abstract_cn: 与传统的基于光栅的光谱仪相比，相干光谱分析仪（COSA）可以通过外差检测将光谱信号转换为电拍信号，从而提供更高的分辨率。然而，外差过程会为每个光谱分量产生两个对称的边带峰值，即镜面效应，这从根本上限制了分辨率。为了克服这一限制，我们在本研究中引入了瞬时频率掩蔽算法来消除镜像效应。实验结果表明，使用之前限制为 6 MHz 的相同硬件，频谱分辨率为 2 MHz。此外，系统中还采用了用于扫描线性化的紧凑型硅光子波长参考，实现了±0.1 pm的长期波长精度。所提出的方法建立了一种具有成本效益的新范式，以超越 COSA 固有的分辨率限制。

data.title: Deep imaging by NIR-II multifocal structured illumination microscopy with enhanced super-resolution radial fluctuation
data.author: Liang Feng, Jiaqi Li, Jie Zhang, Zhigang Yang, Bo Hou, Kai Lou, Junle Qu, Weijia Wen
data.summary: Compared to wide-field (WF) microscopy in the second near-infrared (NIR-II) window, NIR-II multifocal structured illumination microscopy (NIR-II MSIM) provides a twofold improvement in transverse spatial resolution, along with enhanced penetration depth and superior image contrast. These advantages position NIR-II MSIM as a promising platform for studying physiological processes in turbid specimens. However, significant background noise caused by cumulative photon scattering continues to severely degrade image resolution and fidelity. Moreover, the data processing workflow in NIR-II MSIM is highly sensitive to motion artifacts, which further limits its broader applications in live-tissue imaging. To address these challenges, we introduce NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF, a technique that combines NIR-II MSIM with enhanced super-resolution radial fluctuation (eSRRF). This hybrid approach facilitates advanced deep imaging with improved spatial resolution and contrast across turbid specimens, including Intralipid phantoms, ex-vivo pork tissue, and live mice. Notably, NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF could effectively suppress motion artifacts, yielding nearly artifact-free visualization of fine cerebral vessels in vivo. As such, the NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF platform will emerge as a powerful tool for investigating physiological processes in highly scattering environments, thereby accelerating advancements in intravital fluorescence microscopy.
data.title_cn: 通过 NIR-II 多焦点结构照明显微镜进行深度成像，具有增强的超分辨率径向波动
data.abstract_cn: 与第二个近红外 (NIR-II) 窗口中的宽视场 (WF) 显微镜相比，NIR-II 多焦点结构照明显微镜 (NIR-II MSIM) 提供了横向空间分辨率的双重改进，同时增强了穿透深度和卓越的图像对比度。这些优势使 NIR-II MSIM 成为研究浑浊样本生理过程的有前途的平台。然而，累积光子散射引起的显着背景噪声继续严重降低图像分辨率和保真度。此外，NIR-II MSIM 中的数据处理工作流程对运动伪影高度敏感，这进一步限制了其在活体组织成像中的更广泛应用。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF，这是一种将 NIR-II MSIM 与增强型超分辨率径向波动 (eSRRF) 相结合的技术。这种混合方法促进了先进的深度成像，提高了浑浊样本的空间分辨率和对比度，包括脂肪乳模型、离体猪肉组织和活体小鼠。值得注意的是，NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF 可以有效抑制运动伪影，实现体内精细脑血管几乎无伪影的可视化。因此，NIR-II MSIM-eSRRF 平台将成为研究高散射环境中生理过程的强大工具，从而加速活体荧光显微镜的进步。

data.title: Defect‐Assisted Self‐Trapped Exciton Emission in Zero‐Dimensional K 3 InCl 6 Perovskite: Reversible Hydration Switching Toward Multimodal Anti‐Counterfeiting
data.author: Xianzhong Shi, Chunyuan Hou, Baochen Wang
data.summary: ABSTRACT The luminescence origin and underlying mechanism in 0D halide perovskites remain subjects of ongoing debate. In this study, we report on K 3 InCl 6 perovskite that exhibits green emission under specific synthesis conditions. Our investigations reveal that the luminescence in K 3 InCl 6 originates from defect‐assisted electronic transition processes, wherein cation vacancies and anti‐site defects form within the crystal lattice. These defects introduce sub‐band exciton absorption and facilitate the formation of self‐trapped excitons (STE), ultimately leading to radiative recombination and green luminescence emergence. Furthermore, K 3 InCl 6 demonstrates reversible phase transformations upon atmospheric exposure and thermal treatment due to hydration and dehydration processes, enabling spectral and color tunability. This distinctive characteristic positions emissive K 3 InCl 6 as a promising candidate for multimodal anti‐counterfeiting applications. Our findings provide significant insights into elucidating the luminescence origination and mechanism in 0D halide perovskite materials, offering a valuable avenue for future research in this field.
data.title_cn: 零维K 3 InCl 6 钙钛矿中的缺陷辅助自陷激子发射：面向多模态防伪的可逆水合转换
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 0D 卤化物钙钛矿的发光起源和潜在机制仍然是持续争论的话题。在这项研究中，我们报道了在特定合成条件下表现出绿色发射的K 3 InCl 6 钙钛矿。我们的研究表明，K 3 InCl 6 中的发光源自缺陷辅助电子跃迁过程，其中在晶格内形成阳离子空位和反位缺陷。这些缺陷引入了子带激子吸收并促进自陷激子（STE）的形成，最终导致辐射复合和绿色发光的出现。此外，K 3 InCl 6 在大气暴露和热处理时由于水合和脱水过程而表现出可逆相变，从而实现光谱和颜色的可调性。这种独特的特性使发射性 K 3 InCl 6 成为多模式防伪应用的有希望的候选者。我们的研究结果为阐明 0D 卤化物钙钛矿材料的发光起源和机制提供了重要的见解，为该领域的未来研究提供了宝贵的途径。

data.title: 3D Printed Alumina as a Millimeter-Wave Optical Element
data.author: Andrew Yan
data.summary: We present millimeter and sub-millimeter room temperature transmission and loss measurements of 3D printed alumina disc and of a disc with one-sided 3D printed sub-wavelength structures anti-reflection coatings (SWS-ARC). For four bands spanning 158 - 700~GHz we find an index of refraction consistent with $n= 3.107 \pm 0.007$. The loss over the entire frequency band between 158~GHz and 700~GHz spans $ 1 \cdot 10^{-3} \leq \tan δ\leq 2.49 \cdot 10^{-3}$ with 10%-30% uncertainty at the lower range of frequencies shrinking to $\sim\!2\%$ at the higher frequencies. As expected, constructive and destructive interference fringes that are apparent with the flat disc data are absent with the disc that has SWS-ARC. The measured data are consistent with finite element analysis predictions that are based on the measured shape of the SWS. At frequencies between 158~GHz and 200~GHz, below the onset of diffraction effects, reflectance is reduced from a maximum of 64% to about 25%, closely matching predictions. These measurements of the index, loss, and SWS-ARC of 3D printed alumina suggest that the material and fabrication technique could be useful for astrophysical applications.
data.title_cn: 3D 打印氧化铝作为毫米波光学元件
data.abstract_cn: 我们展示了 3D 打印氧化铝圆盘和具有单面 3D 打印亚波长结构抗反射涂层 (SWS-ARC) 的圆盘的毫米和亚毫米室温传输和损耗测量。对于跨越 158 - 700~GHz 的四个频段，我们发现折射率与 $n= 3.107 \pm 0.007$ 一致。 158~GHz 和 700~GHz 之间整个频段的损耗跨越 $ 1 \cdot 10^{-3} \leq \tan δ\leq 2.49 \cdot 10^{-3}$，较低频率范围内的不确定性为 10%-30%，在较高频率范围内缩小到 $\sim\!2\%$。正如预期的那样，具有 SWS-ARC 的光盘不存在平面光盘数据中明显的相长和相消干涉条纹。测量数据与基于 SWS 测量形状的有限元分析预测一致。在 158~GHz 和 200~GHz 之间的频率下，低于衍射效应的发生，反射率从最大值 64% 降低到约 25%，与预测非常吻合。这些对 3D 打印氧化铝的折射率、损耗和 SWS-ARC 的测量表明，该材料和制造技术可用于天体物理应用。

data.title: Super-resolution Imaging of Limited-size Objects
data.author: Nikolay I. Zheludev
data.summary: Improvement of label-free far-field resolution of optical imaging is possible with prior knowledge of the object such as its sparsity or accumulated by a posteriori examination of a similar class of object1-4. We show that the sole knowledge of the object's limited size is another fundamental resource to achieve resolution beyond the Abbe-Rayleigh diffraction limit: a higher resolution can be achieved with smaller objects. To prove this, we developed an imaging method that involves the representation of light scattered from the object with orthonormal field-of-view-limited Slepian-Pollak functions and experimentally demonstrated λ/8 resolution of sub-wavelength objects. Our method requires no assumption of the shape and complexity of the object and its labelling allowing a wide range of applications in the studies of nanoparticles and isolated microorganisms.
data.title_cn: 有限尺寸物体的超分辨率成像
data.abstract_cn: 利用物体的先验知识（例如物体的稀疏性）或通过对类似物体 1-4 类的事后检查积累的知识，可以提高光学成像的无标记远场分辨率。我们证明，对物体有限尺寸的唯一了解是实现超出阿贝-瑞利衍射极限的分辨率的另一个基本资源：使用较小的物体可以获得更高的分辨率。为了证明这一点，我们开发了一种成像方法，该方法涉及用正交视场限制的 Slepian-Pollak 函数表示从物体散射的光，并通过实验证明了亚波长物体的 λ/8 分辨率。我们的方法不需要假设物体的形状和复杂性及其标记，从而在纳米颗粒和分离微生物的研究中具有广泛的应用。

data.title: VAMOS-OCTA: Vessel-Aware Multi-Axis Orthogonal Supervision for Inpainting Motion-Corrupted OCT Angiography Volumes
data.author: Ipek Oguz
data.summary: Handheld Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) enables noninvasive retinal imaging in uncooperative or pediatric subjects, but is highly susceptible to motion artifacts that severely degrade volumetric image quality. Sudden motion during 3D acquisition can lead to unsampled retinal regions across entire B-scans (cross-sectional slices), resulting in blank bands in en face projections. We propose VAMOS-OCTA, a deep learning framework for inpainting motion-corrupted B-scans using vessel-aware multi-axis supervision. We employ a 2.5D U-Net architecture that takes a stack of neighboring B-scans as input to reconstruct a corrupted center B-scan, guided by a novel Vessel-Aware Multi-Axis Orthogonal Supervision (VAMOS) loss. This loss combines vessel-weighted intensity reconstruction with axial and lateral projection consistency, encouraging vascular continuity in native B-scans and across orthogonal planes. Unlike prior work that focuses primarily on restoring the en face MIP, VAMOS-OCTA jointly enhances both cross-sectional B-scan sharpness and volumetric projection accuracy, even under severe motion corruptions. We trained our model on both synthetic and real-world corrupted volumes and evaluated its performance using both perceptual quality and pixel-wise accuracy metrics. VAMOS-OCTA consistently outperforms prior methods, producing reconstructions with sharp capillaries, restored vessel continuity, and clean en face projections. These results demonstrate that multi-axis supervision offers a powerful constraint for restoring motion-degraded 3D OCTA data. Our source code is available at https://github.com/MedICL-VU/VAMOS-OCTA.
data.title_cn: VAMOS-OCTA：用于修复运动损坏的 OCT 血管造影体积的血管感知多轴正交监督
data.abstract_cn: 手持式光学相干断层扫描血管造影 (OCTA) 可以对不合作的受试者或儿科受试者进行无创视网膜成像，但很容易受到运动伪影的影响，从而严重降低体积图像质量。 3D 采集过程中的突然运动可能会导致整个 B 扫描（横截面切片）中的视网膜区域未采样，从而导致正面投影中出现空白带。我们提出了 VAMOS-OCTA，这是一种深度学习框架，用于使用血管感知多轴监督来修复运动损坏的 B 扫描。我们采用 2.5D U-Net 架构，以一堆相邻 B 扫描作为输入来重建损坏的中心 B 扫描，并由新颖的血管感知多轴正交监督 (VAMOS) 损失引导。这种损失将血管加权强度重建与轴向和横向投影一致性相结合，促进了原生 B 扫描和正交平面上的血管连续性。与之前主要侧重于恢复正面 MIP 的工作不同，VAMOS-OCTA 共同增强了横截面 B 扫描清晰度和体积投影精度，即使在严重的运动损坏下也是如此。我们在合成和真实世界的损坏体积上训练我们的模型，并使用感知质量和像素精度指标评估其性能。 VAMOS-OCTA 始终优于以前的方法，可进行具有锐利毛细血管的重建、恢复血管连续性和干净的面部投影。这些结果表明，多轴监控为恢复运动退化的 3D OCTA 数据提供了强大的约束。我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/MediCL-VU/VAMOS-OCTA 获取。

data.title: On-chip electrically reconfigurable octave-bandwidth optical amplification from visible to near-infrared
data.author: Qiushi Guo
data.summary: Achieving broadband on-chip optical amplification spanning the visible and near-infrared (NIR) can enable diverse quantum sensing, metrology, and classical communication applications within a single unified device. However, conventional semiconductor and ion-doped amplifiers suffer from limited gain bandwidths set by fixed energy levels, while optical parametric amplifiers (OPAs) operating continuously from the visible to the NIR have remained elusive due to dispersion-limited bandwidth and the high pump powers required in the visible or ultraviolet (UV). Here, we overcome these limitations by introducing an electrically reconfigurable OPA architecture on lithium niobate integrated photonics. By synergistically combining ultra-high effective $χ^{(2)}$ nonlinearity ($\sim$7,000\%/W-cm$^2$), high-order dispersion engineering, and local electro-thermal tuning of quasi-phase matching, our device achieves record gain spectral spanning more than an optical octave, from 770 to 1650 nm. This range covers key transitions of many photonic quantum systems and all telecommunication bands. Moreover, our approach eliminates the need for high-power, wavelength-tunable visible or UV pumps, delivering a peak on-chip gain of 23.67 dB with a single 1060 nm pump at 90 mW average on-chip power. This work opens new avenues for multi-functional, reconfigurable photonics unifying the visible and infrared regimes, with broad implications for quantum sensing and communications.
data.title_cn: 从可见光到近红外的片上电可重构倍频带宽光学放大
data.abstract_cn: 实现跨越可见光和近红外 (NIR) 的宽带片上光学放大可以在单个统一设备中实现多种量子传感、计量和经典通信应用。然而，传统的半导体和离子掺杂放大器受到固定能级设置的有限增益带宽的影响，而从可见光到近红外连续工作的光学参量放大器（OPA）仍然难以捉摸，因为色散有限的带宽以及可见光或紫外线（UV）中所需的高泵浦功率。在这里，我们通过在铌酸锂集成光子学上引入电可重构 OPA 架构来克服这些限制。通过协同结合超高有效$χ^{(2)}$非线性($\sim$7,000\%/W-cm$^2$)、高阶色散工程和准相位匹配的局部电热调谐，我们的器件实现了记录增益光谱跨越超过一个光学倍频程，从770到1650 nm。该范围涵盖许多光子量子系统和所有电信频段的关键跃迁。此外，我们的方法消除了对高功率、波长可调的可见光或紫外泵浦的需求，在平均片上功率为 90 mW 的情况下，使用单个 1060 nm 泵浦可提供 23.67 dB 的峰值片上增益。这项工作为统一可见光和红外区域的多功能、可重构光子学开辟了新途径，对量子传感和通信具有广泛的影响。

data.title: A Novel Differential Pathlength Factor Model for Near-Infrared Diffuse Optical Imaging
data.author: Mini Das
data.summary: Near infrared diffuse optical imaging can be performed in reflectance and transmission mode and relies on physical models along with measurements to extract information on changes in chromophore concentration. Continuous-wave near-infrared diffuse optical imaging relies on accurate differential pathlength factors (DPFs) for quantitative chromophore estimation. Existing DPF definitions inherit formulation-dependent limitations that can introduce large errors in modified Beer--Lambert law analyses. These errors are significantly higher at smaller source-detector separations in a reflectance mode of measurement. This minimizes their applicability in situations where large area detection is used and also when signal depth is varying. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we derive two distance- and property-dependent DPF models one ideal and one experimentally practical and benchmark them against standard formulations. The proposed models achieve errors below 10 percent across broad optical conditions, whereas conventional DPFs can exceed 100 percent error. The theoretical predictions are further validated using controlled phantom experiments, demonstrating improved quantitative accuracy in CW-NIR imaging.
data.title_cn: 近红外漫射光学成像的新型差分光程因子模型
data.abstract_cn: 近红外漫射光学成像可以在反射和透射模式下进行，并依靠物理模型和测量来提取有关发色团浓度变化的信息。连续波近红外漫射光学成像依赖于精确的微分路径长度因子 (DPF) 来进行定量发色团估计。现有的 DPF 定义继承了与公式相关的限制，这些限制可能会在修改后的比尔-朗伯定律分析中引入较大的错误。在反射测量模式中，当源-探测器间距较小时，这些误差明显更高。这最大限度地降低了它们在使用大面积检测的情况下以及信号深度变化时的适用性。使用蒙特卡罗模拟，我们推导出两种依赖于距离和属性的 DPF 模型，一种是理想模型，一种是实验实用模型，并将它们与标准公式进行基准测试。所提出的模型在广泛的光学条件下实现了低于 10% 的误差，而传统 DPF 的误差可能超过 100%。使用受控模型实验进一步验证了理论预测，证明了 CW-NIR 成像定量准确性的提高。

data.title: Topology-optimized distributed 3d anisotropic Raman emission
data.author: Steven G. Johnson
data.summary: Topology optimization (TO) of 3D surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) substrates faces challenges in managing field singularities and modeling orientation-averaged anisotropic molecules. We present 3D TO for manufacturable SERS substrates that maximize spatially averaged signals from randomly oriented, anisotropic molecules in both elastic and inelastic scattering. A new trace formulation provides a closed-form rotational average of anisotropic Raman tensors, which are not equivalent to isotropic molecules because of tensor nonlinearity. Optimized silver and Si3N4 devices show that lengthscale constraints are sufficient to suppress designs that rely on unphysical mathematical field divergences at sharp corners. Metallic designs deliver broadband enhancement and remain robust to typical Raman shifts, whereas dielectric designs yield narrower, quality-factor-limited gains that are inferior to metallic designs for quality factors below about 500. Our approach readily incorporates additional physics, such as a nonlinear damage model. Together, these results provide a practical route to improved manufacturable SERS substrates and extend naturally to other distributed-emitter design problems.
data.title_cn: 拓扑优化的分布式 3d 各向异性拉曼发射
data.abstract_cn: 3D 表面增强拉曼散射 (SERS) 基板的拓扑优化 (TO) 在管理场奇点和建模方向平均各向异性分子方面面临挑战。我们提出了用于可制造 SERS 基底的 3D TO，可最大限度地提高弹性和非弹性散射中随机取向、各向异性分子的空间平均信号。新的迹公式提供了各向异性拉曼张量的闭合形式旋转平均值，由于张量非线性，该张量不等同于各向同性分子。优化的银和 Si3N4 器件表明，长度限制足以抑制依赖于尖角处非物理数学场发散的设计。金属设计可提供宽带增强，并对典型的拉曼位移保持鲁棒性，而介电设计产生的增益更窄，质量因数有限，在质量因数低于 500 左右时，其增益不如金属设计。我们的方法很容易结合额外的物理原理，例如非线性损伤模型。总之，这些结果为改进可制造的 SERS 基板提供了一条实用途径，并自然地扩展到其他分布式发射器设计问题。

data.title: Microscopy of Bioelectric Potentials using Electrochromism
data.author: Holger Müller
data.summary: Studying the electrical signals generated by living cells is key to understanding numerous biological phenomena. Electrochromic optical recording (ECORE) uses the electrochromism exhibited by certain materials to noninvasively measure these signals in real time. In this work, we report on the development of ECORE based on a high-NA microscope objective. We demonstrate the recording of extracellular action potentials from cardiomyocytes with single-cell resolution and a high sensitivity of 3 μV, which compares favorably to the previous record for any ECORE setup. Combining ECORE with microscopy simplifies the optical setup, allows for the simultaneous imaging of specimens, and makes ECORE accessible to a broader community of researchers, allowing for a better understanding of the biological processes that are integral to life.
data.title_cn: 使用电致变色显微镜观察生物电势
data.abstract_cn: 研究活细胞产生的电信号是理解众多生物现象的关键。电致变色光学记录（ECORE）利用某些材料表现出的电致变色来实时无创地测量这些信号。在这项工作中，我们报告了基于高数值孔径显微镜物镜的 ECORE 的开发。我们展示了以单细胞分辨率和 3 μV 高灵敏度记录心肌细胞的细胞外动作电位，这与任何 ECORE 设置的先前记录相比都是有利的。 ECORE 与显微镜的结合简化了光学设置，允许同时对样本进行成像，并使 ECORE 可供更广泛的研究人员使用，从而更好地了解生命不可或缺的生物过程。

data.title: Enhancing Imaging Depth and Sensitivity in Reflectance Mode Near Infrared Optical Imaging with Scatter Reducing Agents
data.author: Mini Das
data.summary: We investigate the role of scatter reducing agents in a continuous wave (CW) near infrared (NIR)reflectance mode imaging setting. We use food-grade dye Tartrazine as a scatter reducing agent to enhance depth sensitivity and weak-absorber detectability in CW diffuse reflectance measurements. We found that reflectance signal was enhanced when the dye was applied on chicken breast phantom. However, we saw reduced reflectance sensitivity when the dye was uniformly dissolved in intralipid phantom which is a commonly used for NIR imaging studies. This shows that the gradient of refractive index modulation created as the dye diffuses from the top layer allows increased reflectance signal sensitivity of optical photons. However, when the scatter reduction is uniform throughout the phantom (like in intralipid phantom), the improved reflectance sensitivity was not observed. Our study points to significant redistribution of photons with scatter modulation with Tartrazine dye. We show significant improvement in sensitivity to signals with reflectance imaging. To elucidate the underlying mechanism of dye induced scatter reduction in tissue, analytical diffusion models and Monte Carlo simulations were employed. Modeling results show the impact of refractive index gradient created due to dye diffusion in enhancing reflectance sensitivity. These findings demonstrate that dye induced scatter reduction provides a practical, low-complexity approach to improving depth sensitivity in CW diffuse reflectance measurements and extend the functional capabilities of CW-NIRS systems for deep-tissue sensing applications. Our preliminary studies shows up to five fold enhancement in signal sensitivity for signals between two and three cm depth.
data.title_cn: 使用散射减少剂增强反射模式近红外光学成像的成像深度和灵敏度
data.abstract_cn: 我们研究了散射减少剂在连续波 (CW) 近红外 (NIR) 反射模式成像设置中的作用。我们使用食品级染料柠檬黄作为散射减少剂，以增强 CW 漫反射测量中的深度灵敏度和弱吸收体可检测性。我们发现，当将染料涂在鸡胸肉模型上时，反射信号增强。然而，当染料均匀溶解在近红外成像研究常用的脂肪乳模体中时，我们发现反射灵敏度降低。这表明染料从顶层扩散时产生的折射率调制梯度可以提高光学光子的反射信号灵敏度。然而，当散射减少在整个模型中是均匀的时（如在脂肪乳模型中），没有观察到反射灵敏度的提高。我们的研究表明，柠檬黄染料的散射调制可以显着地重新分布光子。我们通过反射成像显示出信号灵敏度的显着提高。为了阐明染料诱导组织中散射减少的潜在机制，采用了分析扩散模型和蒙特卡罗模拟。建模结果显示了染料扩散产生的折射率梯度对增强反射灵敏度的影响。这些发现表明，染料诱导散射减少提供了一种实用、低复杂性的方法，可提高 CW 漫反射测量中的深度灵敏度，并扩展 CW-NIRS 系统在深层组织传感应用中的功能能力。我们的初步研究表明，对于两到三厘米深度的信号，信号灵敏度提高了五倍。

data.title: High-Polarization-Extinction Raman Conversion in Gas-Filled Polarization-Maintaining Hollow-Core Fibers
data.author: Yingying Wang
data.summary: Gas-filled hollow-core fibers (HCFs) have emerged as a versatile platform for high-power nonlinear optics, enabling phenomena from ultrafast pulse compression to broadband frequency generation. However, the lack of robust polarization control has remained a critical obstacle to the deployment of gas-based fiber sources. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by demonstrating the generation of highly-polarized Stokes light via stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) in a nitrogen-filled polarization-maintaining anti-resonant hollow-core fiber (PM-HCF). By exploiting the strong structural birefringence of the fiber, the Raman interaction becomes polarization-decoupled along the principal birefringence axes, leading to threshold-selective Raman amplification and an intrinsic polarization purification mechanism. As a result, the vibrational Raman Stokes emission exhibits a polarization extinction ratio (PER) of 35 dB, even when the incident pump PER is as low as ~2 dB. Through analytical theory and numerical modeling, we validate the underlying polarization-selective Raman dynamics and identify the fiber platform as the dominant factor governing the observed PER saturation. We further show that this high polarization purity and high conversion efficiency is maintained under tight bending conditions with radii down to 5 cm, in stark contrast to conventional non-PM-HCF. These results establish PM-HCFs as a robust and scalable architecture for generating polarization-stable, frequency-shifted light, and indicate that polarization may be treated as an actively engineerable degree of freedom in gas photonics, paving the way toward deployment-ready gas-based fiber sources for precision metrology, quantum communication, and coherent sensing.
data.title_cn: 充气保偏空心光纤中的高偏振消光拉曼转换
data.abstract_cn: 充气空心光纤 (HCF) 已成为高功率非线性光学的多功能平台，可实现从超快脉冲压缩到宽带频率生成的现象。然而，缺乏强大的偏振控制仍然是气体光纤源部署的一个关键障碍。在这里，我们通过在充氮保偏抗谐振空心光纤（PM-HCF）中演示通过受激拉曼散射（SRS）产生高偏振斯托克斯光来克服这一瓶颈。通过利用光纤的强结构双折射，拉曼相互作用沿着主双折射轴变成偏振解耦，从而产生阈值选择性拉曼放大和内在的偏振净化机制。因此，即使入射泵浦 PER 低至约 2 dB，振动拉曼斯托克斯发射也表现出 35 dB 的偏振消光比 (PER)。通过分析理论和数值建模，我们验证了潜在的偏振选择性拉曼动力学，并将光纤平台确定为控制观察到的 PER 饱和度的主导因素。我们进一步表明，在半径小至 5 cm 的紧密弯曲条件下，仍能保持这种高偏振纯度和高转换效率，这与传统的非 PM-HCF 形成鲜明对比。这些结果将 PM-HCF 确立为一种强大且可扩展的架构，用于产生偏振稳定、频移光，并表明偏振可以被视为气体光子学中主动可设计的自由度，为用于精密计量、量子通信和相干传感的可部署的气体光纤源铺平了道路。

data.title: Mitigating Electrode-Induced Polarization Artifacts in Miniaturized Terahertz Detectors via a Ring-Shaped Electrode Design
data.author: Shaozhi Deng
data.summary: Terahertz (THz) polarization detection provides critical insights into material properties but faces a fundamental constraint upon miniaturization: subwavelength metallic electrodes induce strong localization and distortion of the incident field, thereby convoluting the intrinsic device response with electrode-induced artifacts. Here, we overcome this limitation with a ring-shaped electrode architecture that suppresses field perturbations across a broad bandwidth from 2.0 to 5.0 THz. The resonant frequency of the ring electrode can be flexibly detuned from the target operation frequency by adjusting its inner and outer radii, while the smooth, edge-free geometry minimizes the lightning-rod effect. These design features collectively lead to a pronounced suppression of localized THz field enhancement. Numerical simulations reveal an 8.48x reduction in the local field strength compared with conventional rod-shaped electrodes. Consistent with this, experimental measurements on graphene-based detectors exhibit a 6.95x decrease in photocurrent for the ring-shaped electrode relative to the rod-shaped configuration. Moreover, the ring geometry effectively reduces the linear polarization ratio of the photocurrent from >3 to <1.4, confirming its effectiveness in mitigating electrode-induced polarization anisotropy. Our design decouples the detection response from electrode-induced artifacts, enabling compact THz detectors that preserve intrinsic signal fidelity for high-quality polarization-resolved imaging and diagnostics.
data.title_cn: 通过环形电极设计减轻小型太赫兹探测器中电极引起的偏振伪影
data.abstract_cn: 太赫兹 (THz) 偏振检测提供了对材料特性的重要见解，但在小型化方面面临着基本限制：亚波长金属电极会引起入射场的强烈局域化和畸变，从而使固有器件响应与电极引起的伪影相互混淆。在这里，我们通过环形电极架构克服了这一限制，该架构可抑制 2.0 至 5.0 THz 的宽带宽内的场扰动。环形电极的谐振频率可以通过调整其内半径和外半径灵活地从目标工作频率失谐，而光滑、无边缘的几何形状最大限度地减少了避雷针效应。这些设计特征共同导致了局部太赫兹场增强的明显抑制。数值模拟显示，与传统的棒状电极相比，局部场强降低了 8.48 倍。与此一致的是，基于石墨烯的探测器的实验测量显示，相对于棒状配置，环形电极的光电流减少了 6.95 倍。此外，环形几何形状有效地将光电流的线性偏振比从>3降低到<1.4，证实了其在减轻电极引起的偏振各向异性方面的有效性。我们的设计将检测响应与电极引起的伪影解耦，从而使紧凑型太赫兹探测器能够保留内在的信号保真度，从而实现高质量的偏振分辨成像和诊断。

data.title: Evolution of Geometric Phase of light since 1956: A Catalog Review
data.author: A. Srinivasa Rao
data.summary: The geometric phase of light is a fascinating phenomenon in optics and arises whenever there is a change in the polarization state of light. It is a fundamentally well-established concept and has recently found extensive applications, particularly in the development of geometric phase elements that enable efficient manipulation of light. In this tutorial review, we discuss the evolution of the geometric phase of polarization on the Poincaré sphere, from its inception by Shivaramakrishnan Pancharatnam in 1956 to its recent advances and applications. This review article aims to focus on core papers related to the geometric phase of polarization rather than providing an exhaustive literature survey. In this review, first, we introduced the basic parameters and corresponding parameter spheres involved in the geometric phase of light. Then, we provide an in-depth analysis of geometric phase in polarization modes, spatial modes, vector modes, and electromagnetic fields. A brief discussion of applications of the geometric phase is also provided. The intriguing explanation given in this review can awaken new ideas related to the geometric phase of light and can open new directions in fundamental and applied optics. Finally, the tutorial is structured as a comprehensive catalog of the geometric phase of light.
data.title_cn: 1956 年以来光几何相位的演变：目录回顾
data.abstract_cn: 光的几何相位是光学中一个令人着迷的现象，每当光的偏振态发生变化时就会出现。这是一个基本成熟的概念，最近得到了广泛的应用，特别是在开发能够有效操纵光的几何相位元件方面。在本教程回顾中，我们讨论了庞加莱球上偏振几何相位的演变，从 Shivaramakrishnan Pancharatnam 于 1956 年提出到其最新进展和应用。本文旨在重点关注与偏振几何相位相关的核心论文，而不是提供详尽的文献调查。在这篇综述中，我们首先介绍了光的几何相位涉及的基本参数和相应的参数球。然后，我们对偏振模式、空间模式、矢量模式和电磁场中的几何相位进行深入分析。还提供了几何相位应用的简要讨论。这篇综述给出的有趣的解释可以唤醒与光的几何相位相关的新思想，并可以在基础光学和应用光学领域开辟新的方向。最后，本教程被构建为光的几何相位的综合目录。

data.title: Tuning of Localized Surface Plasmons in Vanadium Dioxide Nanoparticles via Size and Insulator-Metal Transition
data.author: Michal Horák
data.summary: Vanadium dioxide has been identified as a promising phase-changing material for use in tunable plasmonic devices. In this study, we present a comprehensive modal analysis of single-phase and multi-phase vanadium dioxide nanoparticles. In-situ high-resolution electron energy loss spectroscopy was utilized to experimentally resolve the dipole plasmon peak, higher-order and breathing plasmonic modes, and bulk losses as a function of nanoparticle size. Furthermore, the focus is directed toward capturing the dynamic nanoscale optical response throughout the metal-insulator transition in a vanadium dioxide nanoparticle. This system possesses the ability to be gradually switched on and off in terms of the emergence of near-infrared plasmonic absorption. The switching is accompanied by a gradual spectral shift of the absorption peak, amounting to 0.18 eV for a 120 nm nanoparticle. It is envisioned that this phenomenon can be generalized to larger nanostructures with a higher aspect ratio, thereby introducing a wider tunability of the system, which is essential for functional nanodevices based on vanadium dioxide.
data.title_cn: 通过尺寸和绝缘体-金属转变调节二氧化钒纳米颗粒中的局域表面等离子体
data.abstract_cn: 二氧化钒已被认为是一种有前途的相变材料，可用于可调谐等离子体装置。在这项研究中，我们对单相和多相二氧化钒纳米颗粒进行了全面的模态分析。利用原位高分辨率电子能量损失光谱来通过实验解析偶极子等离子体峰、高阶和呼吸等离子体模式以及作为纳米颗粒尺寸函数的体损失。此外，重点是捕获二氧化钒纳米粒子整个金属-绝缘体转变过程中的动态纳米级光学响应。该系统具有随着近红外等离子体吸收的出现而逐渐打开和关闭的能力。这种切换伴随着吸收峰的逐渐光谱偏移，对于 120 nm 纳米颗粒来说，光谱偏移达到 0.18 eV。预计这种现象可以推广到具有更高纵横比的更大纳米结构，从而引入更广泛的系统可调性，这对于基于二氧化钒的功能性纳米器件至关重要。

data.title: On-Chip Erbium-Doped Tantalum Oxide Microring Hybrid Cavity Single-Mode Laser
data.author: Xuetao Gan
data.summary: We demonstrate a high-performance, single-mode Er:Ta2O5 microring laser monolithically integrated on a silicon platform via a customized Damascene process. The Er:Ta2O5 gain medium exhibits a low propagation loss of 0.73 dB/cm and a high intrinsic Q-factor of 5.03 x 105. By utilizing a hybrid cavity_consisting of a microring coupled to a U-shaped waveguide at two symmetric points_we exploit the Vernier effect to achieve robust longitudinal mode selection. Under a non-resonant 1480 nm pumping scheme, the laser yields a side_mode suppression ratio (SMSR) of 53.3 dB and a narrow linewidth of 9.5 pm. A slope efficiency of 2.76 % is achieved_the highest reported to date for Er:Ta2O5 lasers_with a lasing threshold of 3.3 mW. Furthermore, stable single-mode tuning is demonstrated across a temperature range of 18_68 celsius, consistently aligning with theoretical transfer matrix models. This work provides a scalable pathway for high-efficiency, tunable on-chip light sources, bridging the gap for monolithic active-passive integration on the tantalum oxide photonic platform.
data.title_cn: 片上掺铒氧化钽微环混合腔单模激光器
data.abstract_cn: 我们展示了通过定制镶嵌工艺单片集成在硅平台上的高性能单模 Er:Ta2O5 微环激光器。 Er:Ta2O5 增益介质具有 0.73 dB/cm 的低传播损耗和 5.03 x 105 的高本征 Q 因数。通过利用混合腔（由在两个对称点耦合到 U 形波导的微环组成），我们利用游标效应来实现稳健的纵向模式选择。在非谐振 1480 nm 泵浦方案下，激光器产生 53.3 dB 的边模抑制比 (SMSR) 和 9.5 pm 的窄线宽。实现了 2.76% 的斜率效率，这是迄今为止 Er:Ta2O5 激光器报道的最高斜率效率，激光阈值为 3.3 mW。此外，在 18_68 摄氏度的温度范围内证明了稳定的单模调谐，与理论传输矩阵模型一致。这项工作为高效、可调谐片上光源提供了一条可扩展的途径，弥补了氧化钽光子平台上单片主动-被动集成的空白。

data.title: Energy Absorption Interferometry
data.author: Willem Jellema
data.summary: Energy Absorption Interferometry (EAI) is a technique for measuring the responsivities and complex-valued spatial polarimetric forms of the individual degrees of freedom through which a many-body system can absorb energy. It was originally formulated using the language of quantum correlation functions, making it applicable to different kinds of excitation (electromagnetic, elastic and acoustic fields). EAI has been applied in a variety of theoretical and experimental ways. It is particularly effective at characterising the multimode behaviour of ultra-low-noise far-infrared and optical devices, imaging arrays, and complete instruments, where it can be used to ensure that a system is maximally responsive to those partially coherent fields that carry signal whilst avoiding those that only carry noise. Despite its utility there is no comprehensive overview of electromagnetic EAI. In this paper we describe the theoretical foundations of the method, and present a range of new techniques in areas relating to sampling, phase referencing, mode reconstruction and noise. We present, for the first time, an analysis of how noise propagates through an experiment resulting in errors and artefacts on spectral and modal plots. A noise model is essential, because it determines the signal to noise ratio needed to ensure a given level of experimental fidelity.
data.title_cn: 能量吸收干涉测量
data.abstract_cn: 能量吸收干涉测量 (EAI) 是一种测量多体系统吸收能量的各个自由度的响应度和复值空间偏振形式的技术。它最初是使用量子相关函数的语言制定的，使其适用于不同类型的激励（电磁场、弹性场和声场）。 EAI 已以多种理论和实验方式得到应用。它在表征超低噪声远红外和光学设备、成像阵列和完整仪器的多模行为方面特别有效，可用于确保系统最大限度地响应那些携带信号的部分相干场，同时避免那些仅携带噪声的场。尽管电磁 EAI 很实用，但目前还没有对其进行全面的概述。在本文中，我们描述了该方法的理论基础，并在采样、相位参考、模式重建和噪声相关领域提出了一系列新技术。我们首次分析了噪声如何通过实验传播，从而导致频谱和模态图上的误差和伪影。噪声模型至关重要，因为它决定了确保给定实验保真度所需的信噪比。

data.title: Universality and anisotropy of the Photonic Urbach Tail
data.author: P. D. García
data.summary: Disorder in photonic crystals and waveguides creates states inside the photonic band gap. These states are often described as Lifshitz tails despite exhibiting energy distributions inconsistent with Lifshitz statistics near the band edge. Here we show that in photonic-crystal waveguides with intentionally engineered anisotropic disorder, the band-edge tail accessible experimentally follows an Urbach law universally, with cumulative statistics $F(Δ)=\exp[-(Δ/α)^β]$, where $Δ$ is the spectral detuning from the band edge, and an exponent $β\approx 1$ independent of disorder strength and orientation. In contrast to Lifshitz behavior, the density of states is maximal at the band edge and decays into the gap. Crucially, we find that the Urbach energy $α$ is anisotropic, with a pronounced directional splitting and qualitatively different scaling for disorder parallel and perpendicular to the waveguide axis.
